messages.subject: [Rnomads-user] Problems reading grib2 files
messages.body_plain:
To whom it may concern,

 

I am trying to read a file using ReadGrib function from rNOMADS library,
nevertheless, I get this error constantly: 

Error in system("wgrib2", intern = TRUE) : 'wgrib2' not found

 

Could you help me to solve it?

 

Thanks in advance for your help
